title.zh: 所得税（Nexstep Discovery 私人有限公司依第 13（12）条享有的豁免）命令 2021
title.en: Income Tax (Nexstep Discovery Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2021

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Nexstep Discovery Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2021.

2.—(1) The following income received in Singapore by Nexstep Discovery Pte. Ltd. (a company incorporated in Singapore) from Nexstep Activity LLP (a limited liability partnership incorporated in the Republic of India) is exempt from tax:
(a)profit distribution amounting to US$643,502 received on 14 June 2018;
(b)profit distribution amounting to US$184,230 received on 19 June 2019.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in paragraphs 3 and 4 of the letter of approval dated 2 August 2021, addressed to IQ EQ Consultants (Singapore) Pte. Ltd.
